definitions.explanation: An abnormally high body temperature, typically 38°C (100.4°F) or above. Used in medical and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {高熱|こうねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高熱|こうねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: The child had a high fever and stayed home from school.

examples.japanese: {三日間|みっかかん}{高熱|こうねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The high fever persisted for three days, so I had tests done at the hospital.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧ (high) + ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ (fever/heat).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高熱|こうねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (develop a high fever)
- {高熱|こうねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (run a high fever)
- {高熱|こうねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (a high fever persists)
- {高熱|こうねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧ (a high fever comes down)

Distinct from ⟦{微熱|びねつ}→微熱：12513_binetsu⟧ (slight fever, around 37-37.5°C) and ⟦{発熱|はつねつ}→発熱：06297_hatsunetsu⟧ (fever in general). {高熱|こうねつ} specifically implies a temperature high enough to cause concern.
